notes.title: New improved look
notes.notes:
Hi.ːsteamhappyː
Today the a new update was released which improved the look of the game a lot. The update also fixed some bugs, like two clayes flying from same thrower and the off hand disappeared at wrong times. 

I am currently working on getting the Sporting mode ready, but it takes some time still. Keep reporting the bugs if you encounter any.

notes.title: Hello everyone
notes.notes: Now that the game has been released, I am working on adding new game modes to the game. Sporting shotgun shooting is coming next and after that probably Doubles will be added. They are both less well known shotgun sports, but they are a lot of fun.
